seal.statement: The storage-load scenario exists on the in-process three-node path (one seed and two joiners in one process, every replica on disk under the run directory, one SQL engine per node): npm run soak:storage creates a handful of single-partition tables, drives a string-keyed write stream and a read stream of already-written keys at a target rate for a duration, and writes data/storage-load/latest.json atomically on every snapshot interval and at the end with the measured write and read figures (attempted, succeeded, ops per second, p50 and p99 latency, per partition and in total), the storage footprint (bytes on disk, SQLite Raft log entries and command bytes, in-memory message-group log entries, RSS) and the growth rates fitted over the snapshots, each report naming the head, the key type, the topology and the end reason; the committed first report is a short run with string keys, and the 24-hour soak is the same scenario with a day's duration, started the moment the short run is green.

text: The scenario exists and wrote the first report. scripts/checks/storage-load-report.js owns the report contract (schema storage-load-report/1: run identity, write/read figures in total and per partition, storage footprint, snapshots, fitted growth) and is the probe. test/storage-load/ holds the in-process three-node cluster (seed plus two joiners, replicas on disk under the run directory via a DataDirectoryManager for the seed and dataDir for the joiners, the schema engine built after the ledger spread because the provisioning owner fences its engine to the membership it was built under), the storage footprint collector (disk walk, SQLite _raft_log counts and command bytes per reachable partition service, in-memory message-group log entries, RSS), a paced load stream, and the runner (npm run soak:storage; atomic report rewrite on every snapshot; SIGINT/SIGTERM end the run with endReason signal; integer keys refused until numeric-key-routing). Contract test under test/storage-load; subsystem rule directory-storage-load; shard censuses regenerated. First report: 2 minutes, 4 partitions, 20 ops/s (10 writes, 10 reads) on head 86f84824b, committed as data/storage-load/latest.json; probe 0. The 24-hour soak started detached at 20 ops/s with 5-minute snapshots under test-output/storage-load/soak.
